items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So Herschel, Basie later sent for Caughey Roberts, the fellow who played first alto with me in China

ctx.x: You'd left Herschel Evans out on the West Coast?

Yes. So Herschel, Basie later sent for Caughey Roberts, the fellow who played first alto with me in China and Herschel came together. And before we left Kansas City all of us were in there. Herschel, myself, Caughey and we didn't have but nine pieces and in order to play some of the places we went, we had to have at least fourteen, fifteen.
And the first job we got was in the Grand Terrace, he that wasn't the first job, but one of the first ones.
